richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Ozhukarai

c: Ozhukarai is the largest municipality in Puducherry, spreading inland from Puducherry town with schools, colleges, residential layouts and industrial estates. FunPlay Systems is an outdoor gym equipment supplier in Ozhukarai for all of these, along with the municipality's parks. We make every machine at our Vasai factory, about 1110 km away, and send it down the east coast by road.

On arrival, a dealer from our south India network or our own installation team fixes each machine into its footing and checks it before handover. Puducherry is hot and humid most of the year and gets its main rain from the northeast monsoon between October and December, sometimes with cyclones. Sea air reaches well inland. Galvanised frames and well-grouted footings are the right choice, and a fresh-water rinse now and then helps machines closer to the coast.

items.q: When should we install an outdoor gym in Ozhukarai?
items.a: Before the northeast monsoon, ideally in the drier months up to September. Grouted footings need several dry days to set, so we agree the date with you after the layout is approved.

items.q: Can an industrial estate in Puducherry order a staff gym?
items.a: Yes. Share the area, the number of workers and photos. We will suggest a set and send a layout drawing and quote for approval.

items.q: How do the machines handle humidity and cyclones?
items.a: Galvanised frames resist rust, and grouted footings hold the machines firm in strong wind. Check bolts and moving parts after each storm season.
